definition: To exist, or to have a certain quality, state or role.
exampleSentence: Good developers try to be clear when they write comments in code.

definition: To own something, or to hold it as a part of you.
exampleSentence: Most offices have a fast internet connection for every employee.

definition: To perform an action or complete a task.
exampleSentence: Please do your homework before you play video games tonight.

definition: To speak words to tell someone something.
exampleSentence: What did the teacher say about the exam next Monday?

definition: To receive, obtain or reach something.
exampleSentence: You will get an email when your order is ready to ship.

definition: To create, build or produce something.
exampleSentence: My grandmother likes to make fresh bread every Sunday morning.

definition: To move or travel from one place to another.
exampleSentence: We usually go to the beach together when the weather is warm.

definition: To have information about something in your mind.
exampleSentence: Do you know the password for the guest Wi-Fi network?

definition: To pick something up and carry it, or to accept it.
exampleSentence: Remember to take your umbrella because it might rain later today.

definition: To notice something with your eyes.
exampleSentence: From the top of the hill you can see the whole city.

definition: To move toward the speaker or toward a place.
exampleSentence: Can you come to my office after the meeting ends?

definition: To use your mind to form ideas or opinions.
exampleSentence: I think this new phone is much faster than my old one.

definition: To turn your eyes toward something to see it.
exampleSentence: Please look at the screen while I explain the next step.

definition: To wish for or desire something.
exampleSentence: Many students want a laptop that is light and easy to carry.

definition: To hand something to another person.
exampleSentence: Could you give me your phone number so I can call you?

definition: To do something with a tool or object for a purpose.
exampleSentence: Most people use a smartphone for messages, photos and maps every day.

definition: To discover something you were looking for.
exampleSentence: I could not find my keys anywhere in the house this morning.

definition: To give information to someone by speaking or writing.
exampleSentence: Please tell your manager if you need more time for the project.

definition: To say or write a question to get an answer.
exampleSentence: If you are lost, ask someone at the station for directions.

definition: To do a job or an activity that takes effort.
exampleSentence: My brother and his friends work at a small software company downtown.

definition: To appear to be something.
exampleSentence: The new students seem happy with their teachers and classes so far.

definition: To experience an emotion or a physical sensation.
exampleSentence: After a long walk in the park I always feel more relaxed.

definition: To make an effort to do something.
exampleSentence: If the app freezes, try closing it and opening it again.

definition: To go away from a place or a person.
exampleSentence: The last train will leave the station at eleven o'clock tonight.

definition: To phone someone, or to shout to get attention.
exampleSentence: I will call you as soon as my plane lands in London.

definition: To require something because it is necessary.
exampleSentence: Plants need sunlight, water and good soil to grow well.

definition: To continue to have or hold something.
exampleSentence: You should keep your receipt in case you want to return the shoes.

definition: To allow someone to do something.
exampleSentence: My parents let me stay up late on Friday nights.

definition: To start doing something.
exampleSentence: The concert will begin at eight, so please arrive a little early.

definition: To make it easier for someone to do something.
exampleSentence: Could you help me carry these heavy boxes up the stairs?

definition: To let someone see something, or to explain how to do it.
exampleSentence: Can you show me how to change the language on this phone?

definition: To notice sounds with your ears.
exampleSentence: I could hear music coming from the apartment next door all night.

definition: To take part in a game, or to make music with an instrument.
exampleSentence: The children play football in the garden after school every afternoon.

definition: To move quickly on your feet, faster than walking.
exampleSentence: My sister likes to run five kilometers before breakfast each morning.

definition: To change position, or to go to a different place.
exampleSentence: Our family plans to move to a bigger apartment next summer.

definition: To have your home in a place, or to be alive.
exampleSentence: My cousins live in a small village near the mountains.

definition: To think that something is true.
exampleSentence: Many people believe that regular exercise improves their mood and sleep.

definition: To carry something or someone with you to a place.
exampleSentence: Please bring a pen and a notebook to the first lesson tomorrow.

definition: To take place, often without being planned.
exampleSentence: Nobody knows exactly what will happen if the power goes out.

definition: To put words or letters on paper or on a screen.
exampleSentence: Every evening she likes to write a few pages in her diary.
